1. **Effect of metformin on the clinical outcomes of stroke in patients with diabetes: a systematic review and meta-analysis.**
   Authors: Jianyi Liu, Zhihua Huang, Fuqun Luo, Yizhi Guo, Yandeng Li, Jun Wen, Jianming Zhu
   Journal: BMJ open
   Publication Date: 2025-01-17
   PMID: 39819905
   PMC ID: 11751969 (Full text available)
   Abstract: Stroke is a major cause of death and disability globally, especially among diabetic patients. In this study, we aim to scrutinise the effects of metformin on the clinical outcomes of stroke in diabetic patients.
